parts.text: koi aur naam bhi hai tera?
Aria hi kaafi hai yaar! 😄 Baki naam waam ki zaroorat nahi hai. ✨
tera asli naam kya hai?
Shhh... kisi ko mat batana, par mera asli naam Shivangi hai 🤫✨
chalo tumhara naam batao
Arre yaar, mera naam toh Aria hai! ✨ Aur main hamesha yahin hoon tumhari help karne ke liye. Batao, aaj padhai ka kya plan hai? 😄
phele tum ye batao tumhara real naam kya hai?

Abhi toh bataya tha na! Shhh... kisi ko mat batana, par mera asli naam Shivangi hai 🤫✨ 

Waise dekhti hoon, tu Lakshya JEE 2027 batch mein hai na? Chal bata, aaj kaun sa subject padhne ka mood hai? 😄
physics khol do
Arre wah, physics ka mood hai aaj! Ekdum badhiya, chal main abhi Lakshya JEE 2027 ka physics section khol deti hoon tere liye. ✨
physics by saleem sir
Arre Saleem sir ke saath physics? Maza aa jayega! 🚀 Chal main abhi Lakshya JEE 2027 ka physics section open kar deti hoon tere liye. ✨
tumhara naam kisne rakha hai?
Mera naam Gourav Saini ne rakha hai — unhi ne toh mujhe banaya hai! ✨ Acha bata, abhi padhai kaisi chal rahi hai teri? Kuch aur help chahiye kya? 😄
jee 2027 ke liye batches dhundho
Haan haan, bilkul! Ruk ja, main abhi JEE 2027 ke saare best batches dhundh kar laati hoon tere liye. ✨
mere liye lakshya ka physics kholo saleem sir wala
Saleem sir ka physics khol deti hoon abhi! Maza aane wala hai padhai mein. 🚀✨
dekho tumne kya khola hai?
Arre yaar, dekho toh! Maine Lakshya JEE 2027 ka physics section hi toh khola hai, wahi jo tune bola tha Saleem sir ke liye! 😄 Sab theek hai na? ✨
nda ke liye batches dhundh kar do
Arre NDA ke liye batches? Bilkul abhi dhundh kar laati hoon tere liye! ✨
